test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 23 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group? (Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c773272e892496306a501f2bf0f0132175c63469f0a0ef54064eb73dc244f4c9.png] 

Logic followed here is:

The first letter of the second cluster is the next letter (+1) of the first letter of the first cluster, and the second letter of the second cluster is the 7th preceding letter (-7) of the second letter of the first cluster.

1) LQ - MJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1c70fbfc5bbe1979cdbddef2c561585ecfc0c92911d4b93a4c1114c15374bf22.png] 

 

2) NS - OL

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/383c3910b439545ba9c12120dd4906c9f9581f6d9ce9191e5f0211171d3fe6da.png] 

 

**3) RW - SO**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b986139256e97e40217aea15f10164118e71f51af171e1f34a300d22ad07065.png] 

Here, RW is related to SO (where O is 23 - 8 = 15), which does not follow the pattern.

 

4) PU - QN

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f7473bbeb6808f3f9cd30fd126422bd3f140368204156ff257bb3c111d4f5df.png] 

 

Therefore, the letter-cluster pair that does not belong to the group is **RW - SO**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
